definitions.gloss: optimism; taking a hopeful or positive view
definitions.explanation: The attitude of expecting favorable outcomes or seeing the bright side of situations. Often contrasted with {悲観|ひかん} (pessimism).

examples.japanese: {楽観|らっかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: It's too early to be optimistic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{楽観|らっかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't be overly optimistic about the situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{楽観的|らっかんてき}→楽観的：06090_rakkanteki⟧な⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He takes an optimistic view of the future.

notes:
USAGE:
{楽観|らっかん} can function as a noun or as a suru verb ({楽観|らっかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to be optimistic about). The derived na-adjective ⟦{楽観的|らっかんてき}→楽観的：06090_rakkanteki⟧ (optimistic) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{楽観的|らっかんてき}→楽観的：06090_rakkanteki⟧な⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧ (optimistic view)
- {楽観|らっかん}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (cannot be optimistic)
- {楽観|らっかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁物|きんもつ}→禁物：13738_kinmotsu⟧ (optimism is dangerous)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲観|ひかん}→悲観：22397_hikan⟧: pessimism — the opposite attitude, expecting unfavorable outcomes
